name: Doctor Voodoo

abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Power Dissolve: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon özel saldırı dışında bir sebeple güç kaybettiğinde, kaybedilen güç oranıyla orantılı doğrudan hasar alır.

signatureAbility:
Brother Daniel
Brother Daniel will possess either Doctor Voodoo or his opponent moving between them based on Doctor Voodoo's combo meter when he uses a Special Attack.
Even Combo: Doctor Voodoo is possessed gaining 100% increased Ability Accuracy and [50 - 125]% increased Buff Duration.
Odd Combo: Opponent is possessed gaining 50% decreased Ability Accuracy and [50 - 125]% increased Debuff Duration.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Increase Energy Resistance by [2,750] while Blocking.

abilitySections.title: Fight Start
content: Gain a Regeneration Buff, recovering [15,140.76] Health over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Doctor Voodoo's Attacks have a 10% chance to place a Loa on their opponent, that lasts until removed by another effect. A Loa is a buff with no effects.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If Doctot Voodoo has more than one Bar of Power, consume 50% of a Bar to place one Loa Buff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On the final hit, each Buff on the Opponent has a 50% chance to be Nullifed. For each Buff Nullified, inflict a [24,932.5] Poison Debuff for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 50% chance to convert up to 3 Loa, Nullifying them and placing either a Buff on himself or a Debuff on the Opponent, based on current Combo Meter.
Even Combo: Gain a Damballa Buff for 15 seconds, giving all attacks a 50% chance to Power Steal 2.5% of the Opponent's Max Power, grant 10% of the Power to Docto Voodoo.
Odd Combo: Inflict a [199.46]% Power Dissolve Debuff for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Power Steal Debuff, stealing 45% of Max Power over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Brother Daniel
content: Brother Daniel will possess either Doctor Voodoo or his opponent moving between them based on Doctor Voodoo's combo meter when he uses a Special Attack.
Even Combo: Doctor Voodoo is possessed gaining 100% increased Ability Accuracy and [50 - 125]% increased Buff Duration.
Odd Combo: Opponent is possessed gaining 50% decreased Ability Accuracy and [50 - 125]% increased Debuff Duration.
